name: calib3w
description: Calibration counterpart of configs/rq2.json: light, middle, and heavy workload levels of four families at d = 2 (M tier) with the seed and split of configs/calib3.json, so the middle-level cells are byte-identical to data/calib3's d = 2 cells and share their predictions. Two rollouts per cell; calibration only (never the test split). See docs/CALIBRATION.md.
